messages.author: Sruthi Sudhakar
messages.body:
Dear all,
We are working on an RNA-binding protein. During the simulation, the volume
of the groove that binds the RNA changes after a particular protein
mutation. Is there a way to quantify this pocket volume throughout the
trajectory? Any help is appreciated.
Regards,
Sruthi Sudhakar
